verdict.rationale: Svelte has no built-in natural-language interface, but it ships an official MCP server that gives an AI agent relevant documentation and static analysis of generated code. It also publishes LLM-oriented docs (llms.txt), so a user can build Svelte apps through natural-language prompts to a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface (e.g. an AI mode in the sv CLI), documentation of end-to-end natural-language workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-driven operation works well.
